title.narrative: CAPACITY: The Danish Migration Management Programme 2024-2029

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the programme is to support priority countries of origin with capacity development and technical assistance within migration management, as well as their capacity on return and readmission, including the provision of sustainable reintegration. The programme has two specific objectives, each with a number of outcomes, that distinguish between a) the capacities, structures and systems necessary for efficient and rights-based migration management in line with global best practices for good governance (e.g. in the areas of identity documents, data and e-systems, physical infrastructure aimed at facilitating safe, legal and regular migration, etc.) and b) supportive arrangements relating specifically to return, readmission and reintegration (e.g. as relating to reintegration assistance, national coordination and referral structures, etc.).
All programme activities are based on the priorities identified by the countries of implementation with the overarching goal of contributing to their economic development and welfare, as well as the rights and well-being of migrants.
